subject: Remove boot strap values after collapsing the tree

messages.author: 3f6899cb6e51c17d
messages.subject: Remove boot strap values after collapsing the tree
parts:
Hi
I am new to ggtree. I am stuck with the problem after I collapse few nodes the bootstrap values of those are still visible and alignment of others much disturbed I am not sure how to fix it. And bootstap values position also becomes quite wired.
Could you please help me attached is also the problematic figure.  

Thanks 

library(ggtree)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(plyr)

tree <- read.tree("Kenya.nwk")
m <- ggtree(tree)
d = m$data
d=d[!d$isTip,]
d$label = as.numeric(d$label)
d$label = round(d$label * 100)
d=d[d$label > 50,]
m + geom_text2(data=d, aes(label=label), hjust=-.2)


z = ggtree(tree)+xlim( 0, 0.006)+
   theme_tree2()
p=z
p

for (n in reorder(tree, 'postorder')$edge[,1] %>% unique) {
  p <- rotate(p, n)
  print(p + geom_point2(aes(subset=(node == n)), color='red'))
}


q=p +
  geom_hilight(node=58, fill="gold")+
  geom_hilight(node=63, fill="blue") +
  geom_hilight(node=77, fill="green") +
  geom_hilight(node=78, fill="red")

q

e <- collapse(q, node=97)%>%

  collapse(node=88)%>%
  collapse(node=81)%>%
  collapse(node=68)

p1=e +ggtitle("Without BootStrap Values")

p2=e+ geom_text2(data=d, aes(label=label), hjust=0.2) +ggtitle("With Boot Strap Values")

e+ geom_text(data=d,aes(x=branch, label=label), vjust=0.1, hjust=-3)


plot_grid(p1, p2, ncol=2)

m + geom_text2(data=d, aes(label=label), hjust=-.2)

the dataset d contains bootstrap values of the collapsed clades, and of course it will be displayed as you intended to display them in the d dataset.

If you want to process the dataset yourself, you have the responsibility to make sure everything works fine.

Otherwise, use the ggtree syntax. If you use ggtree syntax to display the bootstrap values, those values that belong to the collapse clades will also not shown.
